messages:
Maria G.: Heads-up — noticed two small UX/security nits in the console retention/encryption pane. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/ux/console-retention-lock.png

Maria G.: 1) Lock icon in the header has low contrast on the pane bg, looks almost disabled at smaller sizes. 2) Region selector sits above the KMS toggle which makes it read like region scopes encryption — a little confusing.

Jamal (PM): Could you paste the exact copy you saw? Want to check if it's wording or layout causing the confusion.

Maria G.: Copy is: "Encryption: Customer-managed key (KMS)" with a small inline help link. Toggle label is just "Enabled". Screenshot shows the lock icon next to the section title.

Saul (Design): I can repro the contrast issue. On dark theme the lock is ~#6b6f76 which fails AA at 16px. For the layout: agreed — the region dropdown is visually above the KMS block so some folks will assume region selection limits keys.

Saul (Design): Proposal: move the KMS toggle + label to be primary in the block and put region as a secondary field beneath an "Scope" subheading. Also change label to: "Use customer-managed key (optional)" and make the toggle states "On / Off" instead of just "Enabled".

Lexi (A11y): +1 on contrast. Also need aria-labels for the toggle and lock icon. Suggested aria: `aria-label="Customer-managed key toggle"` and add `aria-hidden=false` for the lock SVG with `role=img` and `aria-label="Encrypted workspace"` if it's conveying state. Keyboard order must be: toggle -> help link -> region dropdown (so assistive tech reads encryption controls first).

Maria G.: Great — small copy tweak idea for the help text: "Choose a KMS to encrypt data at rest. This does not restrict which regions the data can be stored in." (helps disambiguate).

design-bot: Mock copy for review:
```
Use customer-managed key (optional)
[Toggle On/Off]  •  Choose a KMS provider (optional)
Help: Choose a KMS to encrypt data at rest. This will not limit region selection.
```

Saul (Design): Will update the mock and adjust the icon contrast to #ffffff at 20px or use a 1px outline to keep it visible. Also add tooltip on hover: "Encryption status".

Jamal (PM): Can we treat this as a P1a? Small scope but user-facing security wording + a11y. If yes, I'll open a ticket with ACs.

Maria G.: Yes, do it. ACs: contrast fix, copy change, toggle aria attrs, keyboard order change, help text edit, tooltip. Please include screenshots for dark/light.

Lexi (A11y): I'll include a quick axe check and keyboard-only walkthrough in the ticket.

Saul (Design): Ok filing design PR today — will link it here when I have the branch.

Jamal (PM): Filed: https://linear.app/RW/issue/UX-4872 "Encryption control clarity & a11y" — assigned to Saul.

Maria G.: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
